notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
When the Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
